reasons: A and B are almost word for word the same. Both correct the 'only the account holder can use it' premise at the start, separate legal family sharing (共济) from lending your own card, which is the actual violation, give the right Oct 16, 2026 nationwide launch date for the medical-insurance wallet (医保钱包), compute 2400 yuan a year, and send the mother to get her chronic disease registered first. Both share the same flaws. They state an Anhui-wide 200-yuan cap and city figures without sources, they say the sharing quota can pay Anhui's resident premium (a trap the key lists), and they leave out that the quota cannot be withdrawn as cash. B is slightly better: its savings range (1140-1440) and its years estimate (8000 ÷ 960-1260) agree with its own arithmetic, where A's 1100-1400 and '8000 ÷ 1000 ≈ 6-8 years' do not. B also drops A's unsourced Tongling quotation in favor of telling her to call the local insurance bureau or 12345, and it fixes A's pronoun typo (他 for 她).
